structuredContent.summary: Added native integration tests for preloaded subscription bundles. Tests verify that preloaded bundles survive terminal download failures until explicit opt-out, that newer downloads only replace bundles after storage activation, and that existing installed data is not downgraded by failed updates. Uses synthetic version 203001010001 for precedence.
test_gaps: No test case for concurrent storage completion and download callback execution.
recommended_changes: Ensure `RealBundleProvider` uses a mockable configuration source to avoid dependency on global `config::GetPreloadedSubscriptionConfiguration()` in unit tests.
